model: 1D explicit finite-difference heat diffusion in a homogeneous EVA slab
property_source: Tomšič et al. (2025; first published 2024), Advanced Theory and Simulations 8(3), 2401026, DOI 10.1002/adts.202401026, Table 1
limitations: Idealized constant-property 1D EVA slab only; property values are literature inputs, not measured AGASTYA material values.
Prescribed 100 C hot-face temperature is an ideal boundary condition, not a hot-knife temperature or contact model.
No glass, cells, backsheet, adhesive chemistry, moisture, contact resistance, moving knife, foam roller, peel/fracture, convection, losses, power, throughput, emissions, or separation-quality model.
The calculated energy is sensible heat within the idealized layer and excludes equipment losses and other layers.
No experimental validation; outputs do not establish safe operating conditions or delamination.
validation_needed: Measure temperature-dependent properties and boundary/contact histories on approved coupons; compare instrumented profiles and energy with a qualified supervised setup.
